key_insight: DEScover uses four LLM agents to discover physically interpretable DES subgrid length scales based on grid width normal to the local vortex axis.
engineering_relevance: The framework could accelerate turbulence-model development while improving DES accuracy over the standard maximum-cell-size length scale.
method: Start with a user-specified physical modeling idea.
Use four agents to propose, review, implement, and evaluate candidate formulations.
Infer vortex axes using vortex-identification methods and generate CFD simulation scripts.
evidence_signal: Across a flat plate, backward-facing step, free shear layer, and iced airfoil, the best candidate consistently outperformed the standard length scale and matched or slightly exceeded an expert-designed shear-layer-adapted alternative.
watch_item: The reported average discovery time of about 25 minutes excludes CFD simulations, and performance beyond the four tested cases remains unestablished.
paper_title: Automated Discovery of Physically Interpretable Subgrid Length Scales for Detached Eddy Simulation via Agentic AI
